data.name: Hafij
data.gender_notes: Hafij is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is filled with knowledge and wisdom, a scholar or sage. The name Hafij carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Hafij usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Hafij belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafij total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It suggests a deep devotion towards knowledge and learning, reflecting the value placed on education and wisdom in Hindu society. The title is often given to those who have attained a significant level of scholarly prowess, whether in religious or secular fields.
data.spiritual_significance: "Hafij" is a name that resonates with spiritual depth and intellectual prowess. It implies a strong connection to the divine wisdom that flows through the universe and is accessed through relentless study and contemplation. The pursuit of knowledge is seen as a means to attain enlightenment, and the title "Hafij" symbolizes a person who has dedicated themselves to this endeavor, making them a beacon of wisdom and guidance for others.
